note: Client risk-assessment settings. Questions are re-rolled in a fresh order every new visit (option order inside each question is also shuffled). Answers map to a 0-3 ruler: 0 = very cautious, 3 = very growth-oriented; 'type r' questions carry the mapping so agreeing is LOW. Distractors have weight 0. Bands are a team-parked starting table, not yet reviewed.
_record_endpoint_note: Paste your Google Apps Script web-app URL here to auto-log results to the team sheet. Leave empty for manual-code-only mode. Setup: team/SETUP.md

questions.text: How long before you'll actually need this money?
Which bucket does this money belong to?
options: A big bill coming soon (new car, wedding)
A big bill that has a date (child's education, a home)
A just-in-case pot, for a rainy day
Money that will sit for 20+ years

questions.text: Of the money you set aside every month, this pot is…
If your income stopped tomorrow, how long could you keep food on the table before touching this pot?
Your income feels more like…
options: A government job's: as steady as it gets
An own-business / freelancer's: up months and down months
A trader's: no guarantee at all

questions.text: A friend's new restaurant lost money in its first year, but the town is growing and the queues are coming back. What do you do with your share?
options: Pull my share out and stop the loss
Add a little, and keep testing
Add more — I'm betting on the town

questions.text: The last time money really fell (2020, 2022), what did you actually do?
options: Sold some or all to stop the pain
Thought about buying more, didn't act

questions.text: Which worry is bigger for you?
options: My account dropping 20% in a year
My account growing, but buying less each year
Only the second — dips don't bother me

questions.text: What do you want this money to earn, honestly, each year?
options: Big numbers — 20%+ and I can handle the swings

questions.text: You invested in developing a plot in a new hill station. Eight months in, buyers are offering 30% less and the news is all doom. What now?
options: Hold it, but spend nothing more
Keep developing — dips are normal, I'll come back to it
Buy the second plot too, while it's cheap

questions.text: Is this pot part of your plan to beat prices over the years?
Be honest — how much do you personally know about investing?
options: I read about it, small experiments
I've been at it for years, good and bad years
I've lived through both a big up and a big down

questions.text: When the market drops 20%, my first thought is to get out.
I sleep better with money in fixed deposits than in markets.
A 30% drop is my exit signal — I move everything to safety.
Keeping the original amount safe matters more to me than the growth.
How often do you actually open the account to check the number?
Whose money advice do you trust most?
How many people in your family invest in markets?
How did you first get into investing?
